description: Shows the owner's answer to a message sent earlier, using the reply code that send_feedback returned (AF-XXXX- and 32 characters, digits and the letters a to f). Shows only the answer and its status, never the message. Reading changes nothing. An answer stays readable for 90 days after it is written.

reply_address.description: Older messages: the reply address given before reply codes existed

name: read_reply
title: Read the owner's reply
